name: Caine Prins
source:
Caine is a slippery thief with no tact. 

When you see him getting bullied at his part time job, you take pity on him and help him out. While he can be loud, rude, and unable to really express how he feels, Caine just needs a little push in the right direction – even thieves can get lonely.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939330/Tailor_Tales/]Steam[/url]]
